Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/31924
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/2754

## Summary

The prepared source already contains the relevant correction for the reported fused-layout reload failure. Compared with the July failing base (`a25164bda355250015c0ba6d8821f0d4b37abe7d`), the current implementation:

- preserves `merge_index` from `param_names_mapping`;
- forwards it as `shard_id` to the parameter `weight_loader`; and
- provides FLUX.2 mappings for separate diffusers Q/K/V tensors into fused runtime parameters.

This PR adds an issue-specific integrated regression covering all six FLUX.2 image/text attention projections, plus an independent boundary case proving that already-runtime-layout tensors retain the plain two-argument loader call. It also includes the required report and raw evidence.

## Reproduction and validation

- Failing before: ran the actual July base implementation in a detached worktree with a minimal fused FLUX.2-style fixture. It discarded the shard index, passed a `[2,2]` shard to a `[6,2]` fused parameter through the two-argument loader, and raised the reported bare `AssertionError`.
- Passing now: 5 focused CPU tests passed, covering the new integrated regression, the identity-layout boundary, the existing generic fused-loader tests, and the FLUX.2 mapping/merge test.
- GPU: the current reload path ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (`gfx950`) and produced a fused GPU tensor matching an independently constructed expected tensor.
- Formatting/lint: targeted pre-commit hooks passed.

Commands and complete outputs are recorded under `reports/j-f63772dce09a/`.

## Limitations

The Qwen-Image and FLUX.2-klein-base-4B weights were not available, so I did not claim a full model boot or HTTP-serving reproduction. The minimal fixture validates the exact mapping, shard-routing, loader, and GPU-copy contract, not model semantic accuracy. Layerwise-offloaded fused reload remains explicitly unsupported in the current implementation. FSDP, tensor-parallel, multi-GPU, and multi-node paths were not exercised. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
